book.name: Jon
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Jon kaavu

content: Malia kaasêêh bel galovasa lak Yesu vaha

+ o 12:1 Jon 11:1,43*Busin namaavaalu naahen de ti sen naatu vindak tii-to ond naatu busin haluusin sen Anutu haluuh hil Islel hôôk vu Ijip bôôy-ato, tonde Yesu lo-valup Betaani sen yêêvu Lasalus be kandi lak vu yimbin-atêêto.
+ o 12:2 Luk 10:40*Tombe lawiing Yesu-te vanôôn vuu-ju, tombe Maata yoo monaluuh vanôôn, de Lasalus nando having vaatêêvak-aso be mondaya vanôôn having Yesu.

+ o 12:3 Luk 7:37-38*Tonde Malia hako bel galovasa hôôk buayo bop ti, bel galovasaa-ju ond daanggo lak mone bopaata lôôt, ond valup-ambe kaasêêh ak Yesu vaha de laavu lak luvalus, tombe bel galovasaa-jo galôôn vapuuh-ambe lohvu bayêên alo pin.
+ o 12:4 Jon 6:71; 18:3*Lemu Yesu-te maanggêêm ti, haale nambe Yudas Iskaliot, ond ngaaho lak in navu taato Yesu langaah-ambe hil lanôôh-ato, ond nêêl nambe,
+ o 12:5 Mat 19:21*“Nambe vaati sen yame aavu bel galovasaa-ju be hil baanggo jak mone 300 kina, de monêê-jo yaambu vu hil sen dativak in va yuuh amêê-to?”

Lemu Yudas-ame ka vu hil sen dativak in va yuuh amêê-to ondeey nêêl nambêênju le, malis, nganjo yi omaaho hôôndak ambu in yoo nanggin Yesu having maanggêêm-asote laayul mone-têêto, tombe mone sen daasu hôôk-ato ond yoo nahôôndak vaalu.
+ o 12:7 Jon 19:40*Le Yesu nêêl nambe, “Jipin vêêh-anju, ham-ame naanêêl yi le, in yoo hatung bel galovasaa-ju vu sa be gêên navu taahu sate busin kanu sen saanggimb-ambe landaav saa-to.
+ o 12:8 Diu 15:11*De hil sen dativak in va yuuh amêê-to sil e mando gaving ham nohvu busin pin, nganjo sak same le mando gaving ham nohvu busin pin e.”
Yêêv-aso salivangin-ate lanjôôy vakasin in nambe lanyiis Lasalus be jimb

+ o 12:9 Jon 11:43-44*Hil Yuda ngeeyaata lalak ni nambe Yesu nando Betaanii-jo om sil lala. Lemu sil-ame lala in lanji Yesu mu le, malis, nganjo lawiingin nambe lanji Lasalus sen bôôy Yesu yêêvu be kandi lak vu hil yimbin-atêêto.
Tombe kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso lanjôôy vakasin in nambe lanyiis Lasalus-ambe jimb gaving,
+ o 12:11 Jon 11:45*in hil Yuda ngeeyaata kand vu Lasalus tombe lavuuh silate yêêv-aso de lawii-having Yesu.
Yesu lukala Yelusalem lohvu omaaho lulemak ti
Heendiiy atombe hil ngeeyaata sen lalaam dando lung la in lanji busin bop busin haluusin-ato lango nambe Yesu valup in naam Yelusalem.

+ o 12:13 Saam 118:25-26; Mat 27:42; Jon 1:49*Om sil lako haah alis osin nama be lala latovu Yesu vu mopaatôôv, tombe daakôôhin nambe, “Ham-o, yiiy lavangg dôôk Anutu, de yiiy gako omaahôô-ja haale jak in laam ak Omaaho Bop haale. Yiiy Islel-ate omaaho lulemak yi.”
Tombe Yesu tovu donggi daka be lakando be la, lohvu Anutu-te vakasin neep hôôk kaapiya nambe,

content.text: + o 12:15 Sek 9:9*“Ham Saion-e, ham-ame anjêênin e.
Ham angge hamate omaaho lulemak nando lak

content: + o 12:16 Jon 2:22*Tombe yite maanggêêm-aso me-lalak vaa-jo dangga ni pavis e, le taamusin Yesu kandi lak-ambe haale tu bopaata lak lung la, le mem sil akand vu laah Anutu-te vakasin sen neep hôôk kaapiya munggin-ato, tombe mem lalak ni nambe lawiing vakasin-anjuuto nôôn ak lohvu.
+ o 12:17 Jon 11:43-44*Tonde hil ngeeyaata sen daale having Yesu de teey Lasalus vu bandumb-ambe kandi lak vu yimbin-ate be laam-ato, ond mondanêêl Yesu banye lôôt,
tombe hil pin lango banye nambe Yesu wiing taahu taahu osin niwêêk-anju ondeey lala latovu yi vu mopaatôôv.
+ o 12:19 Jon 11:48*Tonde Palisai-so yoo lanêêl vu sil nambe, “Ke, ham angge, yanêêngg vakasin nôôn ma in hil pin lala davu taamuyin yi.”
Hil Glik heey lawiingin nambe lanji Yesu
Tombe hil Glik heey lala lalup Yelusalem in lanohak vu Anutu dôôk busin bop-anju gaving.
+ o 12:21 Jon 1:44; Luk 19:3; 23:8*Tombe sil lala vu Pilip sen baan Betsaida vu Galilii-to, tombe sil kataangg yi nambe, “Himbop, hey aawiingin nambe aangge Yesu.”
Tombe Pilip la nêêl vu Endru, le mem Endru having Pilip-ambe yuuh lala lanêêl vu Yesu.
+ o 12:23 Jon 13:31-32; 17:1*Tombe Yesu nêêl laah vu yuuh nambe, “Busin tok laam lung laa-jo in nambe Omaahonôôn Noow navu gako haale bop.

+ o 12:24 1Ko 15:36*De sa naanêêl keen vu ham naambe saakom ve nôôn ti nambe yame gavuk dukana ngaanggis e, ond saakom ve nôôn timuu-jôôto yoo le mando. Le naambe yiiy gavuk dukana ngaanggis-ambe me balup-ande naavi panyek ond mem le nyiis nôôn ngeeyaata jambaale.
+ o 12:25 Mat 16:25*Omaaho ti yoo ahe having ninaavi vu voon-anjo ond le na menama, de omaaho ti nimbaya ninaavi vu voon-anjo ond le mando metumin danggata.

+ o 12:26 Jon 14:3; 17:24*De omaaho ti nambe nôôh sate kul ond le taamuyin sa, tombe taaku sen sa mandôô-to ond sate hil kul vaha-so le mando gaving sa. Tonde omaaho ti nambe gako sate kul ond Aamangg e gako yi jak.”
Le gasi Omaahonôôn Noow jakana

+ o 12:27 Saam 6:3; 42:5; Mat 26:38*“Gêên-anjo sa longgpayo nimeen lôôt, om sale naanêêl vaati? Mak sa naanêêl naambe, ‘Aamangg, ganôôh sa vêêl in va sen navu naatovu sa peey-anjo?’ Malis, me-lohvu sa naanêêl naambêênjo le, in sa nando be gêên-anjo in nambe sa baaku nimeen peey.
+ o 12:28 Mat 3:17*Om Aamangg, goo gambiing ohaalem naatu bopaata jak.” Tonde lava ti laam vu baandoni nambe, “Saawiing-ambe sa haalengg bop ak lung la, tonde sale aambiing-ambe bop jak jesin naah.”
+ o 12:29 Sin 23:9*Tombe hil sen daale dangôô-to lanêêl nambe, “Kalang tuuh.” Tonde hil vaalu lanêêl nambe, “Angela ti vakaas vu yi.”
+ o 12:30 Jon 11:42*Le Yesu nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Vakasin-anju me-laam in nambe sa gango le, malis, nganjo laam in nambe ham gango.
+ o 12:31 Jon 9:39; 14:30; 16:11*Gêên Anutu navu sahi hil voon-ate vakasin jakana, de gêên-anjo navu gatiiy omaahonôôn-ate heendin anipaya Saalang vu voon-anjo na.
+ o 12:32 Jon 3:14*In gêên sa nando voon, le busin sen sil gasi sa jakanaa-to ond sale daandiiy omaahonôôn pin naam vu sa.”
+ o 12:33 Jon 18:32*Nêêl vakasin nambêênju in taato naambe le jimb ak haah pako.

+ o 12:34 Saam 89:4,36; 110:4; Ais 9:7; Dan 7:14*Tombe hil lanêêl laah vu nambe, “Hey hango tanasin neep hôôk Anutu-te kaapiya nambe omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato ond le mando danggata, le nambe tana sen ganêêl nambe le gasi Omaahonôôn Noow jakana? Omaahonôôn Noow-anju lati?”

+ o 12:35 Jon 7:33; 8:12; 1Jon 2:10-11*Le Yesu nêêl laah nambe, “Kin tumin-ato le naatum vu ham daka gaving e, om ham oo ana hôôk melangaah in le mekanu dôôk in ham. In omaaho ti na hôôk mekanu ond le doosin mop sen naa-to,
+ o 12:36 Ep 5:8*om gêên ham ambiing gaving kin tumin sen naahen nando having ham-anjo, ond mem ham e naatu hil melangaah-ate.” Yesu nêêl nambêênju lung la, tonde la hôôpis in sil.
Hil Yuda ngeeyaata me-lawii-having Yesu le
Yesu wiing taahu taahu osin niwêêk ngeeyaataa-ju hôôk hil amend, le me-lawii-having yi le,
+ o 12:38 Ais 53:1; Lom 10:16*in nambe Yesaia-te vakasin nôôn ak sen nêêl langaah nambe,

content.text: “Omaaho Bop, laheey lawii-having heyate vakasin? De Omaaho Bop taato yite niwêêk vu lati?”

content: Ondeey sil-ame lalohvu nambe lambiing gaving Yesu le, in Yesaia nêêl vakasin ango be neep nambe,

content.text: + o 12:40 Ais 6:10; Mat 13:15*“Anutu wiing-ambe sil amend kanu hôôk, de wiing-ambe sil alondpayo niwêêk ak, in nambe sil-ame lanji va jak mend e, osin kand-ame bu vakasin danggakook e, de me-langgilin londpayo nom vu sa in nambe saambiing-ambe nind vasa jak e, malis.”

content: + o 12:41 Ais 6:1*Yesaia yi me lak Yesu-te nikaapulis ondeey nêêl vakasin nambêênjo lak Yesu.
+ o 12:42 Jon 7:48; 8:30; 9:22*Tonde yêêv ngeeyaata lawii-having Yesu, le dayêênin hil Palisai om me-danêêl langaah e, in nambe le gatiiy sil lana nanyendangga.
+ o 12:43 Jon 5:44*Keen, yêêv-asôônju me-lawiingin nambe Anutu gako sil haalend jak e, nganjo sil oo kand navu nambe omaahonôôn gako sil haalend jak ond mem nivasa.
Yesu-te vakasin oo le bu nyevahaan vu omaahonôôn
+ o 12:44 Mat 10:40*Yesu teey la langaah nambe, “Omaaho ti nambe biing gaving sa ond me-yoo wii-having sa le, nganjo wii-having omaaho sen wiing sa be sa laam-ato having.
+ o 12:45 Jon 14:9*Tonde omaaho ti nambe ji me jak sa ond yik yi me lak omaaho sen wiing sa be sa laam-ato.
+ o 12:46 Jon 8:12; 12:35*Saalukalaam voon-anjo nambe kin tumin in nambe hil pin sen sil alondpayo naam timu vu saa-to ond sil-ame mando hôôk mekanu le.

+ o 12:47 Jon 3:17; 8:15*Tonde omaaho ti gango sate vakasin-ambe mesamu le, ond same le aambu nyevahaan vu yi le, in same alaam voon in nambe gangoyin omaahonôôn-ate vakasin e, malis, nganjo soo alaam in nambe aandôôvu omaahonôôn.

+ o 12:48 Hiblu 4:12*De omaaho ti nambe galuuh dami vu sa de me-gako sate vakasin jak e, ond yite va sen le bu nyevahaan vu yii-to nando, yik vakasin sen sa naanêêl-anjo ond yoo le naanêêl yite nipaya langaah naambe le gako nyevahaan dukanaah vu busin taamusin.
In same yoo naanêêl vakasin lohvu sa kangg e, malis, nganjo Aamangg sen wiing sa be sa laam-ato ond yoo nêêl vakasin pin vu sa nambe soo tatekin osin sa naanêêl.
+ o 12:50 Jon 8:26,28*De sa lak ni nambe Mangg-ate vakasin le biing-ambe ham mando metumin danggata, om va sen sa naanêêl ond sa naanêêl lohvu Mangg nêêl vu sa lung laa-to.”
